recognize_zh: 這是分子檢測圖：上方為全基因組拷貝數散點圖（log2 fold change），紅圈標示 17 號染色體 TP53 位點拷貝數缺失；下方兩張 IGV 讀段截圖分別顯示 TP53 p.H179R 錯義突變與 c.782+2T>G 剪接位點突變，代表 TP53 雙等位失活。
features: Top: genome-wide copy-number plot of log2 fold change by chromosome with dashed gain/loss thresholds
Red circle on chromosome 17 marks TP53 copy-number loss (values below baseline)
Additional apparent segmental losses on chromosome 5 and a focal region of chromosome 13 below the threshold
Bottom left: IGV read pileup showing a variant column annotated TP53 p.H179R (missense)
Bottom right: IGV read pileup showing TP53 c.782+2T>G (canonical splice-donor variant)
describe_en: Molecular figure from next-generation sequencing. The upper panel is a genome-wide copy-number plot of log2 fold change by chromosome, with a circled region on chromosome 17 indicating TP53 copy-number loss; segmental losses are also suggested on chromosome 5 and part of chromosome 13, although exact boundaries cannot be read from this image. The lower panels are IGV read-alignment views showing two TP53 variants, a missense p.H179R and a canonical splice-site c.782+2T>G, with high variant read representation. Together these indicate multi-hit TP53 inactivation, which in blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm is uncommon and associated with adverse prognosis; the more typical BPDCN alterations (TET2, ASXL1, ZRSR2, loss of 9p21/CDKN2A, 12p13/ETV6, 13q) should be sought.

ddx.dx: Therapy-related myeloid neoplasm or AML/MDS with mutated TP53
ddx.vs: Multi-hit TP53 with 5q/17p loss is the hallmark of TP53-mutated AML/MDS, so lineage must be established by immunophenotype (CD4/CD56/CD123/TCF4 versus MPO/CD34/CD117).
A variant allele frequency near 50% persisting in non-hematopoietic tissue indicates germline origin, which requires testing of skin fibroblasts or other constitutional DNA.
